claim_ceiling: Synthetic paired sensor/laboratory measurements for software verification only. Not a field observation, permit result, ecological threshold, site clearance or environmental compliance finding.

standards_context.uncertainty_method: JCGM GUM first-order linearized uncertainty propagation cross-checked against JCGM 101 deterministic distribution propagation
standards_context.nonlinear_model_policy: Apply JCGM 100:2008/Amd.1:2026 nonlinearity guidance. The fixture uses a deterministic Monte Carlo cross-check; real measurements require justified input distributions, covariance and model adequacy assessment.
standards_context.water_sampling_reference: ISO 5667-10:2026, representative sampling of urban/industrial wastewater including cooling water

pairing_contract.pair_rule: Every flow, thermal and concentration observation in an interval must use the exact same interval_id, interval_start_utc and interval_end_utc; clock offset must not exceed the declared limit.

flow_closure_boundary.rule: This closure screen is only applicable to the explicitly declared single-pass, no-side-stream fixture. A real system with purge, bleed, bypass, recirculation, cleaning, leakage, evaporation, storage/holdup change or multiple outlets requires a full signed multi-stream mass balance and cannot use this two-meter screen.

flow_closure_screen.method: absolute outfall-minus-intake flow residual divided by combined standard uncertainty
flow_closure_screen.purpose: instrument-flow closure screen for this declared synthetic single-pass boundary only; not a full water mass balance, discharge permit or ecological threshold

equation_contract.thermal_power_standard_uncertainty_kw: first-order partial-derivative propagation for independent rho, cp, flow and delta-temperature inputs
equation_contract.net_pollutant_mass_flux_standard_uncerta: root-sum-square of independently propagated intake and outfall concentration/flow uncertainties
equation_contract.covariance_assumption: Inputs are treated as independent for this synthetic fixture. Any shared calibration, common reference or correlated errors require covariance terms or Monte Carlo propagation; independence must not be assumed silently.

datastream_result_encoding.unit_location: Unit of measure is part of resultType field structure
datastream_result_encoding.legacy_unit_of_measurement: not used in v2.0 Datastream contract

ogc_sensorthings_mapping.data_model_policy: Local normalized bundle only, not a SensorThings API payload. Preserve phenomenonTime and resultTime separately; preserve Datastream resultType and resultEncoding; model sampling locations and sampled environmental features with Feature, linking observations through ProximateFeatureOfInterest and Datastreams through proximate/ultimate feature links. Query server $metadata before assuming optional extensions. v1.1 adapters, if ever needed, must be explicit versioned translations rather than silent aliases.

uncertainty_simulation.framework: JCGM 101:2008 distribution propagation with JCGM 100:2008/Amd.1:2026 nonlinearity guidance
uncertainty_simulation.distribution_assumption: Independent normal instrument/property inputs plus one common normal hydraulic-residence-time perturbation shared by output-side flow, temperature and concentration. Assumptions are synthetic test conditions, not site-measured distributions.
uncertainty_simulation.acceptance_rule: If Monte Carlo and first-order standard uncertainties differ by more than the declared tolerance, or any simulated physical input becomes nonphysical, return no qualified measurement receipt and require model review. This is an engineering cross-check, not a complete JCGM conformity assessment.
